mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the main credit and reconstruction institution for revival of sick units."
NBCI is the main credit and reconstruction institution for revival of sick units.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a lecturer while Alhaji Muhammed Jibrin is a multi-millionaire businessman."
Obaka Abel is a lecturer while Alhaji Muhammed Jibrin is a multi-millionaire businessman.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the United States with approximately 6.5 percent of the total voting shares, followed by Japan with approximately 5.4 percent."
The largest ADF shareholder is the United States with approximately 6.5 percent of the total voting shares, followed by Japan with approximately 5.4 percent.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a United Nations international financial institution that provides loans to developing countries for capital programs."
The World Bank is a United Nations international financial institution that provides loans to developing countries for capital programs.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a contract between the lessor and lessee, whereby the lessor allows the use of his specific asset such as equipment by the lessee for a certain period."
Lease is a contract between the lessor and lessee, whereby the lessor allows the use of his specific asset such as equipment by the lessee for a certain period.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a prerequisite for IDA's membership."
Membership of IBRD is a prerequisite for IDA's membership.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of policies or conditions that the IMF requires in exchange for financial resources."
IMF conditionality is a set of policies or conditions that the IMF requires in exchange for financial resources.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the group banking and the chain banking which are also found in the USA."
Two other important types are the group banking and the chain banking which are also found in the USA.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the capacity development branch of the World Bank, providing learning and other capacity-building programs to member countries."
The World Bank Institute is the capacity development branch of the World Bank, providing learning and other capacity-building programs to member countries.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a contract between the assurer (the company) and the assured (i.e. the policy holder) whereby the assurer undertakes to pay benefits to the policy holder on the attainment of a specified event."

Life assurance business is a contract between the assurer (the company) and the assured (i.e. the policy holder) whereby the assurer undertakes to pay benefits to the policy holder on the attainment of a specified event.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a popular device for protecting the drawer and payee of a cheque."
Crossing is a popular device for protecting the drawer and payee of a cheque.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most prevalent banking system in the majority of countries."
The branch banking is the most prevalent banking system in the majority of countries.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the money owned by customers and therefore it is a liability of a bank."
Deposits are the money owned by customers and therefore it is a liability of a bank.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the five major multilateral development banks in the world that provides assistance to its regional member countries with a view to helping them achieve their development goals."
The AFDB is one of the five major multilateral development banks in the world that provides assistance to its regional member countries with a view to helping them achieve their development goals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a situation in which three or more banks that are independently chartered are controlled by a small group of people."
Chain banking is a situation in which three or more banks that are independently chartered are controlled by a small group of people.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a federal government-owned development bank with a mandate to provide low-cost credit to small holder and commercial farmers, and small and medium rural enterprises."
BOA is a federal government-owned development bank with a mandate to provide low-cost credit to small holder and commercial farmers, and small and medium rural enterprises.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a dynamic and rapidly growing one."
The Nigerian insurance industry is a dynamic and rapidly growing one.
fib: ______ is the unit of account of the IMF and represents a claim to currency.
Special Drawing Right
The Special Drawing Right is the unit of account of the IMF and represents a claim to currency.
______ is a pool that mobilises long-term funds from Nigerian workers, banks, insurance companies and the federal government to advance loans at soft interest rates to its contributors.
NHF
The NHF is a pool that mobilises long-term funds from Nigerian workers, banks, insurance companies and the federal government to advance loans at soft interest rates to its contributors.
______ are the money, which the bank has accumulated over the years from its undistributed profits.
Reserve funds
Reserve funds are the money, which the bank has accumulated over the years from its undistributed profits.
______ is a prerequisite for membership of the IFC.
Membership of the World Bank
Membership of the World Bank is a prerequisite for membership of the IFC.
______ refers to a bank which offers a wide variety of financial services beyond the strict traditional boundaries of a commercial bank.
'universal bank
A 'universal bank' refers to a bank which offers a wide variety of financial services beyond the strict traditional boundaries of a commercial bank.

Suspension/termination from the IBRD's membership

bilateral development bank

A bilateral development bank is a financial institution set up by one individual country to finance development projects in a developing country and its emerging market, hence the term bilateral, as opposed to multilateral.
______ refers to a collection of financial institutions set up for the purpose of granting long-term loans.
capital market
The capital market refers to a collection of financial institutions set up for the purpose of granting long-term loans.
______ is the ex-officio Chairman of the IFC Board of Directors.
IBRD's President
IBRD's President is the ex-officio Chairman of the IFC Board of Directors.
______ is a type of bank that provides services such as accepting deposits, making business loans, and offering basic investment products.
commercial bank
A commercial bank is a type of bank that provides services such as accepting deposits, making business loans, and offering basic investment products.

International Monetary Fund (IMF)

IMF
The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is an international organisation that was initiated in 1944 at the Bretton Woods Conference and formally created in 1945 by 29 member countries.

A financial institution is an establishment that conducts financial transactions such as investments, loans and deposits.

Cheque
Cheque is an important negotiable instrument which can be transferred by mere hand delivery.

bankers draft
A bankers draft is an order, addressed by one office of a bank to any other of its branches or by one bank to another, to pay a specified sum to the person concerned.

Nigeria
Nigeria is one of the countries where informal financial institutions continue to play an important role.

Crossing of a cheque
